question: Q4 alternatives: other embeddings, other free sets
number: Embedding alternatives: all 8! = 40320 assignments of digest words to m8..m15 give 595 ops in 40320 of 40320 (exact trace; every chain word is a lane variable of bound 2^32-1, so an assignment only renames input registers). Free-set alternatives (ops, fed-back width): m8..m15 595 (256 bits), m8..m14 590 (224), m8..m13 560 (192), m8..m11 525 (128), m8..m9 485 (64); each missing word costs 2^16 in time (Q2), all 16 words free 730 ops. No alternative is cheaper in score.
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|m14|msgword|Q4. validation: b3r3lib.py selftest (7-round official vectors for empty input and [0]; organizer verifier/blake3.py at 3 and 7 rounds on 600 random 0^32||x; trace total 595 and per-kind counts = filed rho.py PH/PH_BY)
held_fixed: target 0^32||x (m0..m7 = 0, m8..m15 chain words, identity embedding), standard IV/counter 0/length 64/flags 11, 3 rounds, filed circuit rules (7 lanes x 36-bit pitch, filed Tracer rules, 595 ops per batch of 7); all other reads unchanged; the search is the plain birthday chain of the filed entry
reopen_if: an embedding that is not a renaming and removes work (for example a digest word that already equals a message-read sum), or a non-injective embedding with a counted collision-rate gain
